authority_basis: Control Center disposition after Issue #502 and merged PR #503 authorizes the exact FORDHAM-1990-91-031 NCAA non-appearance qualifier correction to be exposed for Owner Gate 1 review without reopening Research.

challenges.evidence_basis: Fordham institutional history establishes that the Patriot League lacked an automatic bid; Fordham lost the NCAA-administered Saint Francis play-in, then still awaited an NCAA at-large bid, did not receive one, and entered the NIT. The game is therefore a qualifier outside the national bracket rather than an NCAA Tournament appearance.
